Sgt. Balm has the hots for Shurq Elalle, jealous of Skorgen Kaban and the tavern keeper keeping her company
Cpl. Deadsmell knows she volunteered to deliver Shake Brullyg’s casks
Deadsmell makes fun of Sgt. Balm for looking at a dead girl with lots of puns
Throatslitter tries to hold in his laugh but bursts out in his trilling, uncanny laugh. His throat was damaged from swallowing flaming oil
Sgt. Balm accuses Deadsmell of being a necromancer
Everyone in the tavern looks at Throatslitter because of his crazy sounding laugh, Shurq Elalle and Skorgen Kaban leave
Throatslitter follows after them
Shake Brullyg watches the Malazans in his home
Lobe and Galt play a game with knuckle-bones, split feathers, and a bowl
Masan Gilani sits by the door, whom he is thirsty for
Sgt. Balm and Sgt. Cord had come to Second Maiden Fort and made a deal with Shake Brullyg which he accepted desperately
If they deal with the mountains of ice in the sea then they could be royal guests as long as they like
Shake Brullyg was adept at learning languages and knew Letherii, Shake, Tiste Edur, Fent, trader’s tongue, and Meckros
Unknown to the Malazans, he was learning Malazan at a fast pace. But he is not smart
Brullyg asks Masan to go on a walk with him
Masan stretches seductively, the other two wonder if they should get another whore for him
Brullyg beat the first whore they gave him that Deadsmell had to revive her
Brullyg is frightened of Sinn, who could appear from a swirl of light whenever her name is called
Galt stood up and looked at a thousand year old, wall-sized tapestry that depicted the First Landing of the Letherii
Official revised history records that the Letherii founded Gedry at the mouth of the Lether river
The true first landing occured on the opposite side of the Reach, where they invaded four Fent settlements, slaughtered the men, enslaved the women and children
Brullyg admires the Letherii’s ability to revise history
Galt thought the writing was similar to [Seven Cities] Ehrlii script
Lobe, after dismantling Galt’s knife out of boredom, recalls that Cord/Ebron had recognized that Ehrlii and Letherii came from the same language [First Empire]
Lobe hears unfamiliar footsteps approach, the Malazans get into position, passing Galt’s knife back without missing a beat
Lobe pulls a crossbow from under the table, the weapon entirely made of metal, the string thick as a thumb, and the bolt with an x-shaped head
Masan Gilani holds a knife at Brullyg’s back
Galt speaks broken Letherii as he greets Shurq Elalle and Skorgen Kaban
Brullyg convinces to let them in and hold up the Malazan facade against his better judgment because of his infatuation with Masan Gilani
Shurq Elalle and Skorgen Kaban sit down, wanting to leave on their Undying Gratitude ship but finding themselves prevented by a blockade
Throatslitter appears at the doorway to announce the Malazan’s waiting is done
Galt says they’re going to make Brullyg’s estate their HQ and flirtatiously winks at Shurq Elalle
Throatslitter says Deadsmell can perceive that she’s undead
Shurq says her appetite is as lively as ever, Galt sweats
Fist Blistig recalls the events that followed the Bonehunters flight from Malaz City along with the Perish Grey Helms
The Bonehunters can never return home
Three days east of Kartool, Fist Keneb suggested Lostara Yil step up to be Tavore’s aide in place of the deceased T’amber
Tavore was too despondent to react to news of the Bonehunter’s possible mutiny, Lostara Yil managed the remaining 8,000 soldiers
Grub knew about Banaschar’s treasure hoard that he accumulated while investigating the slaughtered temples of D’rek, Lostara Yil used it to pay off the Malazan soldiers
The Malaz 14th Army now had money, but questioned their purpose, whom did they fight for? They did not want to become mercenaries
Lostara Yil entered Tavore’s chambers and they had a conversation. Whether an argument or discussion isn’t known, but it awoke something in Tavore out of her despondency
Tavore called a meeting to give a speech to the Fists and officers ranking captain and above on the Froth Wolf
Through Sinn and Banaschar’s sorcery, her voice was heard by all soldiers of the Malaz 14th Army
Tavore considered the Bonehunters are learning its own secret language as the following armies had achieved through their campaigns in the past
Dassem Ultor - the Plains of Unta, the Grissian Hills, Li Heng, Y’ghatan
The Bridgeburners - Raraku, Black Dog, Mott Wood, Pale, Black Coral
Coltaine’s 7th Army - Gelor Ridge, Vathar Crossing and the Day of Pure Blood, Sanimon, the Fall
The Bonehunters - Aren, Raraku, Y’Ghatan, Malaz City

As the Bonehunters wear bones tied to their belts, Tavore is reminded of the Theft civil war in which a warleader captured its rival army and ordered to cut off their index fingers, sending 12,000 home maimed
Feels the Bonehunters feel the same trauma as those maimed soldiers
Tavore gives the Bonehunters an objective, to give vengeance upon the Letherii Empire for committing genocide upon the isle of Sepik, a protectorate of the Malazan Empire
Considers themselves Malazans in spite of Empress Laseen
Compassion is never enough. Nor is the hunger of vengeance
‘What awaits you in the dusk of the old world’s passing, shall go… unwitnessed’, T’amber’s words
As commander Tavore declares ‘We shall be our own witness, and that will be enough. It must be enough. It must ever be enough.’
The words had awakened the soldiers, to rail against the injustice of being unwitnessed, not a single soldier deserted
Back to the present, Tavore had ordered to burn their transport ships to send the message that the Bonehunters have arrived to the Letherii Empire
Lostara Yil thinks to herself as Tavore’s fleet had sailed past the Jaghut ice mountains and have arrived at Second Maiden Fort
Six ships including the Silanda and the Perish Grey Helms are anchored at bay
Fist Blistig was removed from command
The last Perish ship, a Throne of War, blockades the harbor entrance
Adjunct Tavore speaks with Lostara Yil
Sgt. Cord’s squad is on the northwest tip of the island, Sinn is keeping the ice mountains away and no one knows how
Grub says the world is drowning. The boy is still a mystery, especially since he can talk to the nachts (who came with Withal and Sandalath Drukorlat from the Crippled God’s realm)
Sgt. Balm and Cpl. Deadsmell stand at the pier awaiting their arrival
An owl watches as a Letherii troop approaches the Malazans
(Letherii Coast, Owl)
Sunrise, an owl watched Letherii troops march on a coastal track between the beach ridge and forest line. The weather is misty
The owl sees some shrubs and brambles vanish, figures appear from nowhere [Fiddler’s squad]
The owl feels a tug on its mind as if something left [Bottle]
(Letherii Coast, Fiddler)
Bottle releases the Mockra illusion obscuring the 14 Malazan soldiers
Bottle had used the owl to peak and see the 30 Letherii light armored lancers. Bottle senses one of the Letherii is “sensitized”
Bottle, Fiddler, Tarr, Koryk, Smiles, Cuttle, Gesler
For the past month the soldiers have been on a reverse sleep cycle, most of them lost their tans
Fiddler and Gesler speaks their thoughts in private
Adjunct Tavore burned their ships, to make the Malazan presence known to the Letherii Empire and to make the Malazans know there’s no turning back
Tavore wants to fight against the Tiste Edur spread thin, not knowing if the Letherii people are truly oppressed and would be friendly to the Malazans
Gesler and Fiddler share concerns how they’re invading with only two squad units mortally dependent on one mage
Now that the Malazans had arrived on Letherii soil, the invasion feels real and their waiting is over
Sgt. Hellian is drunk. She swam off of the burned transport ships and orders her soldiers to carry the casks of ale
Among the soldiers are Bowl, the twins Touchy and Breathless who Hellian thinks is one person, Balgrid the bearded mage, sapper Maybe, Lutes, tall Tavos Pond
Cpl. Urb appears with one other person
Sgt. Hellian vaguely orders to fight the Tiste Edur hiding behind the trees
Fist Keneb leads his 40-man platoon in a swamp of a forest along the Letherii coast
Keneb sends Gullstream to fetch Cpt. Faradan Sort
Keneb thinks to himself

Thinks about how quickly Tavore reorganized the Malaz 14th Army after leaving Malaz City. All of the magic users were to be their main communications and Mockra rituals were now universally known to camouflage themselves
Keneb thinks Tavore had planned this invasion from the start without telling any of the officers
Tavore held meetings with the Meckros smith Withal and Sandalath Drukorlat, the Tiste Andii from Drift Avalii. Neither who are from Lether

Keneb’s platoon had encountered two crippled Edur ships. They slaughtered the warriors and bloodily interrogated the officers, acquiring most information from their logs and charts [Note: These were the destroyed Edur ships that Shurq Elalle found on the way back home to Lether]
Keneb wonders what Tavore’s objective is
The Edur slaughter of Sepik and other people under the Malazan Empire’s protection was Empress Laseen’s problem. Wonders why Tavore holds to the title of Adjunct, with no superior
They are no longer a part of the empire that wants them dead, wonders if Tavore and Laseen had planned another ruse like with Dujek and the false outlawry of his Host and Bridgeburners
However, the loss of T’amber and the Wickans were too much and made no sense
Keneb knew if the 14th Army marched upon Malaz City there would have been civil war
Tavore had lost all of her inner circle
Fist Tene Baralta of the Red Blades is dead, Fist Blistig has no hope for the future
Cpt. Faradan Sort appears, choosing Beak from Sgt. Gripe’s squad as her mage. She’s confident in his magic skills to maintain communication and track down their soldiers scattered along the coast
Keneb’s platoon begins marching inland
Keneb and many of the soldiers are not content
Their objective is to destroy the Tiste Edur, free the Letherii from their oppression so they can rebel and start a civil war
A civil war Tavore was unwilling to start in Malaz City
Beak is a socially awkward 36 year old mage that loves magic with extremely low self esteem, but adored nonetheless
Beak was born to very rich noble parents in Quon Tali. His mother had an incestuous relationship with his brother and beat Beak when he stood up one night
All of Beak’s tutors called him stupid and also beat him. No one else disagreed with them and thus Beak believed he was stupid as a fact
Whenever Beak blabbers out of his life, people would either hug him and walk away or just cry in front of him 🥺

A Seti witch in charge of his family stables taught Beak magic first. She recognized Beak’s sorcery as a lone candle in the darkness, his brain snuffed the other candles so this one could burn brighter
The Seti witch found other servants to teach Beak the other warrens, which he felt were colored candles
Grey for Mockra, green for Ruse, white for Hood, yellow for Thyr, etc
Beak’s candles would lean towards other magic, which Cpt. Faradan Sort wanted to use to find the other squads
Beak’s last tutor, a half-Fenn blacksmith, had Beak list all the candles Beak had. Beak has access to all warrens
When Beak was 29 years old, the half-Fenn blacksmith gave him a long knife and told him to run away and join the Malazan army so he wouldn’t be beat anymore
Beak’s parents had punished the half-Fenn blacksmith for giving Beak the knife by whipping him and turning him away
When the family tried to take the knife back, Beak had unleashed his candle and mostly likely killed his family and destroyed his family estate
[Note: Erikson confirms in a 2021 conversation with his advance reader, AP Canavan, that Beak obliterated his family]
Fist Keneb leads to platoon across swampy waters and they reach an island
Beak gets excited and recognizes [Gothos’] Omtose Phellack sorcery is melting, which created the swamp waters. Broken bodies of Forkrul Assail and Liosan and ghosts are under the rocks
All the soldiers stared at Beak, unnerved how Beak knew these things which explains why he feels not liked
Beak explains a skirmish of the Just War was fought between the Forkrul Assail and the Tiste Liosan here on these ruins
Where Keneb was standing, the last warrior that died was a Forkrul Assail that had a hole in her throat. Her last thoughts before death was that victory proves they were right and the enemy was wrong
Beak explains the ghosts can eat into their brains and make them think terrible thoughts, resulting in killing each other

Further explains Justice is a weak god with too many names, speaks in a mysterious language none of his followers could understand, resulting in it having no power and his followers would make up their interpretations which is why no one could agree with each other. Thus the Justice Wars never end
Beak offers to summon a ghost to ask it questions which Cpt. Faradan Sort immediately shuts down
Cpt. Sort asks Beak for directions. 1000 paces north is the edge of Omtose Phellack and the shortest way out which is where Sort and Beak will travel
Since Keneb’s platoon wants to head further inland, they head west which takes 1200 paces to exit the swamp
Sgt. Cord, Cpl. Shard, mage Ebron, and sapper Crump watch as the mountains of ice crash against Fent Reach
Shard says his sister, Sinn, has been acting differently ever since Y’Ghatan and hasn’t been talking to him. She doesn’t sleep much anymore, he “doesn’t recognize much of Sinn these days”
Sinn is in an old abandoned lighthouse, unweaving the Omtose Phellack sorcery which accelerates the ice melting and sea level rising. She’s weaving something else too

Withal, the Meckros blacksmith, reflects on how he was comfortable living in Malaz City. He had been there after Mael rescued him from the Crippled God and told to wait for someone that turned out to be Tavore
Withal has spent a year on the ship with Adjunct Tavore, yet knows little about her.
Has yet to tell her that he forged the sword which gives Emperor Rhulad his power
Believes both Tavore and Rhulad are tools of the gods, to face off against each other
Sandalath Drukolat, Tiste Andii wife to Withal, banters with him
Withal wishes he could go back to smithing simple things like horseshoes
Sandalath said they should address the young Tiste Andii. Rake’s children whom he and uncle Andarist ‘abandoned’
Sandalath Drukorlat is speaking to all of the Tiste Andii about Second Maiden Fort becoming their home for awhile

Nimander Golit looks upon his daughter Phaed (whom he feels is like his sister, Tiste Andii multigenerational relations are weird), a walking red flag of resentment and murder. Phaed is crazy and wants to kill Sandalath
Nimander sees traits shared among the Tiste Andii
Introverts devoid of introspection
Darkness in the blood
Chimera even unto themselves
Followers of people like Rake
Nimander wants to care about the Throne of Shadow they were supposed to defend, but just sees all the lives wasted on it
In Midnight Tides

Sandalath Drukorlat is a Tiste Andii that died during the wars between the Tiste Edur and the K’Chain Che’Malle. Her spirit was summoned when the Seren Pedac and the Crimson Guard were lost traversing Kurald Galain to escape from the Edur invasion. When the job was done, Iron Bars threw a ring containing her soul so that her spirit could rest at sea.

Withal was a Meckros blacksmith, and the last survivor of the Third Meckros City after mountains of ice had destroyed it. The Meckros are people that live on man-made floating islands raided coastlines for slaves. Withal was rescued and enslaved by the Crippled God, his freedom in exchange for crafting the mottled sword which eventually found its way to Rhulad. Despite completing the task, the Crippled God did not keep his promise.

To keep Withal company and cheer him up, the Crippled God resurrected Sandalath Drukorlat for Withal to take as a companion. When Withal prayed to Mael for help, the god appeared and gave Withal and Sandalath a boat to escape the Crippled God’s warren.
In Bonehunters

T’amber with the help of the Eres’al created a doll and gave it to Bottle so he could find Withal who ended up in Malaz City with Sandalath. Bottle brought Withal, Sandalath, and the Tiste Andii survivors back to Malazan 14th Army, where Withal could inform Tavore everything he knows about the Crippled God
In House of Chains

Andarist (brother to Anomander Rake and Silchas Ruin) guarded the Throne of Shadow with a group of young Tiste Andii that were not named at the time. When the Edur invaded and killed Andarist, a person named Traveller took over the duty and sent the Tiste Andii away with old guard Malazan marines [who disappeared after Laseen usurped Kellanved, Shadowthrone and Cotillion mourned them] that had been stranded on the island
In Bonehunters

Nimander and the Tiste Andii had been in a shipwrecked, were rescued, and taken to Malaz City. At Coop’s Hanged Man’s Inn, Sgt. Braven Tooth had met them and learned Nimander Golit was Anomander Rake’s first son. At some point, Lady Envy got revenge on Rake by having a daughter, Phaed, with Nimander. Later Sandalath Drukorlat and Withal had taken the Tiste Andii survivors with them to board Tavore’s ship, the Froth Wolf
Hedge and Emroth walk across the rotted ice of Omtose Phellack
Debris of broken furniture and tools were everywhere, the only weapon being Imass suggested it was a slaughter
The duo reach a hill where the Jaghut bodies were gathered, and a mummified Jaghut sits on a throne made of ice. Not the true throne
Emroth states the spirit had left the Jaghut’s body
Hedge mentions that Obo, the Malaz City scholar [from ICE’s Night of Knives], had witnessed the death of a star. A light disappeared suddenly when comparing star charts
Emroth said the Imass Bonecasters could not agree, but another explanation is that stars faded when they move away. Suggests both are true
Onrack enjoys the sensation of his revived flesh and blood Imass body. Putting his hands in cold stream water, picking up smooth rocks, cutting his shins as he walks through arctic rose bushes

Onrack’s appearance. Dark brown hair to his shoulders, facial hair along his jaw and mouth but not on his cheeks, broad and flat nose, deep inset eyes, heavy brow ridge. His body was short, but huge. Long muscular arms, stubby fingers, bowed legs with knees as wide as his hips, yet moved lithely. Amber skin.
Onrack had the kind of smile that was infectious and made you want to be his friend, eyes full of childlike wonder
Landscape. Tundra and forest with caribou, ledges with goats
Over the week, Onrack would disappear into the forest and return with more of his own crafted tools, sew his own hide-skin bag, and raw material supplies
One night around the campfire, Onrack paints yellow marks on his body as he hums to himself
A pack of ay wolves have been scavenging from Onrack’s hunts for 3 days, attracted to Onrack’s wolf song “Agkor Raella” and caribou song “Allish Raella”
Onrack plans to hunt a male emlava hunting cat which can easily kill the ay wolves
Night passes, the next day walk up a crevasse to caves that contain the source of the stream water, the emlava is striped saber-toothed tiger
Trull and Quick Ben offer help, Onrack says he’ll be okay on his own because x7 ay wolves appear to support Onrack
Trull (Erikson’s anthropology brain) wonders if eliminating rival predators, not hunting prey together, was how domestication of wolves to dogs started
Onrack uses a stone-weighted antler atlatl and readies to throw his spear
[Trivia: Atlatl is a tool helps you throw a spear with more accuracy and force, acts like an additional joint on your arm. Was used by humans since in the Upper Paleolithic period (30,000 years ago)]
Onrack throws the spear, piercing deep into its chest
The ay wolves charge, the emlava grabs one of the ay wolves with both claws, bites its neck, and crushes the ay with its body weight
Two ay wolves on each side bite into the emlava’s belly, the tiger spins to defend itself leaving its neck exposed to Onrack’s sword thrust
The emlava falls back, dead
The x6 surviving ay retreat out of sight of the party
Onrack and Quick Ben discuss how these were the first wars. The Imass hunted their prey to extinction, and the non-domesticated ay wolves starved to death
Onrack made a mistake, the emlava was female and its mate may still live
Onrack wonders if this realm was a gift to do things differently, as their extinct prey lived again
Wither bothers Udinaas of talk about sinking into the stone of the K’Chain Nah’ruk ruins around them
The party rests on a shattered platform, soon they’ll reach the center of the crater. Udinaas recognized that something like a meteor or sky keep crashed here

Wither is shocked that Udinaas knows things he shouldn’t, wonder if he has a “fell mentor”. Udinaas believes he’s just a broken slave, a failure of a person, that uses his brain because he doesn’t like feeling stupid
Udinaas’ yelling wakes the party up
Fear tries to console him, that he was skilled in mending fishnets
Seren found puddles of gold like from a picture frame
Silchas Ruin explains the frames were used to stretch the K’Chain Nah’ruk’s molted skin so they can use it as parchment
Fear jokes that Silchas Ruin knows a lot about a people he killed on sight
Clip laughs, revealing Silchas Ruin parlayed with the Nah’ruk during a civil war
Seren notices the group’s marching order
Silchas Ruin and Clip far ahead, then Seren, 20 paces behind is Kettle, Fear, and Udinaas using the Imass spear as a walking stick
Wonders if she’s isolating herself, or if she doesn’t trust Silchas and Clip as their guide falling back on her own duty as Acquitor
Silchas wanted to head west, but avoided Rhulad and Hannan Mosag. Does he really feel threatened if he can turn into a dragon? Silchas then leads them north to Bluerose where Tiste Andii are hidden
A voice that claims to be Mockra speaks to Seren
Warrens may be alive. Chaos is a web lying over all the other warrens, its voice shapes magic. Each strand is energy waiting to be shaped by an Elder God’s intent
K’rul understood that warrens need a grander form of a living body with an aversion to disorder
Not chaos, Light, or Dark

K’rul’s own body is not enough, he must have a dialogue of power with something else. This other entity must face K’rul only and turn away from everything else. The blood flows out weakened, then flows in strengthened.
Mockra warns Seren Pedac of how to cope with the trauma of her rape, that remembering it would relive it and may drive her to suicide

Mockra says Seren is blessed and knows the warren more intimately than Corlo of the Crimson Guard who mentored her, that she should choose someone to experiment on with her cruel power. She will need to discover the enemy eventually
Seren decides not to experiment for now
The party comes to check up on Seren who’s been kneeling and speaking to herself
Udinaas can sympathize with hearing someone else’s voice, but he also asks her to stop using her power to shift her knee pain into his
Yan Tovis, Yedan Derryg, and the Shake lancers arrive on horseback to a swampy little village
Yan Tovis sends Yedan to gather Pully, Skwish, and the other Shake witches and warlocks to meet at the tavern
Yedan asks her not to send the Shake to war
At the base of the tavern, Yan Tovis reads an epitaph written in Shake runes of Teyan Atovis, former Rise (title for Shake King) a thousand years ago
The Year of the Isle is different from the the Burn’s Sleep calendar
Yan Tovis understood the king died under the debts to the Letherii and drank himself to death
Yan Tovis opens the door, Pully and 200 of the Shoulderfolk of the Old Ways (Shake coven of witches and warlocks) are already inside
“Cob to web” is the Shake coven’s long distance communication ability. All of the Shake know Yan Tovis is now Queen after her mother passed away
Yan Tovis notices there more witches than warlocks, males born with too many demonic traits are killed
Yan Tovis announces that she will not be a part of the Old Ways ritual. The Rise [King] must be chosen by all Shake, not just by the coven
The Old Ways have failed the Shake and Yan Tovis intends to do what she believes for the survival of her people
As Queen, she still needs the healing and blessing of the coven, but they will rule no more
The coven look at Yan Tovis with shock, anger, and growing malice
Night time, Fiddler’s group have spent three nights sleeping in the daytime only traveling at dusk. Walking inland on old roads passing the occasional farmstead
Contemplates on wanting to be Strings, a new name with this new army but can’t shake off his legacy
Thinks about how the Bonehunters need a real fight to boost morale. Y’Ghatan was walking into a trap, Malaz City they fought their own people.
Wanted to do a Deck Reading, thinks about Tattersail. Bottle also advises against it
Fiddler’s group haven’t found any enemy Tiste Edur yet
Stormy says Gesler had last watch, Stormy worries about the Silanda
Stormy’s creeped out by Bottle frequently masturbating, Fiddler explains it’s actually a ghost haunting him [The Eres’al]
Gesler went off by himself in the night pondering why there are a dozen wells in the glade
Gesler thinks about his war trauma and his triggers
The campfire reminds him of Truth sacrificing himself when he ran into a burning palace in Y’Ghatan
His crossbow reminds him of Pella with a bolt shot through his head in Y’Ghatan
The crows squawking reminds him when ghosts attacked a camp of Korbolo Dom’s Dogslayers
His own hands and knuckles remind him of Coltaine at Vathar Crossing
He remembers the Logros T’lan Imass slaughtering Aren, nearly wiped out the city if the ex-Red Blade [Barathol Mekhar, who was accused of opening the gates to let the T’lan Imass in]
Stormy comes, looking for Gesler
They talk about the war. They’ve been in 38 battles (37 for Stormy because he missed Y’Ghatan)
Koryk is impatient to kill an enemy, either Edur or Letherii bandits. Has a long knife he stole from Smiles. Makes up some bandit names for people to kill
Smiles the names from Malazan stories
Pamby Doughty with the feather in his hat and his hunchback sidekick
Pomolo Paltry the Sly
Zorala, a child that climbed the tallest tree in the forest, stuck for years until woodsman came
Stealers of the royal treasure of Li Heng. Cutters of the Great Rope that held Drift Avalii in place
Corabb thinks the Malazans are a lot different from the Dogslayers or the Rebels. More like animals
For the most part the Malazans ignored him, which Corabb preferred
Sgt. Fiddler assigned Corabb to stay close to guard Bottle
Corabb thinks about mages, deals with gods, how Leoman made a deal with the Queen of Dreams and ran away. Thinks Fiddler is a more worthy person to follow
Corabb and Bottle talk
Bottle likes having bats around, like the rats he admitted he shipped to the Froth Wolf to spy on Tavore
Bottle asks about Leoman and the deal he made with the Queen of Dreams. Corabb doesn’t want to talk about it
Bottle senses the land is deathless, ghosts tangled in every root. Owls can see the dead
(Trantalo Kendar)
Trantalo Kendar is a 19 year old Beneda Tiste Edur, youngest of four brothers
Was 15 when his aunt’s apprentice while she was a healer in Hannan Mosag’s army
Lost his eagerness for war when he saw how traumatized and crippled the casualties of war were. Walking among the dead and dying, looking at the lost limbs, scarred faces, lost futures
Trantalo was riding with eleven Edur warriors led by his oldest brother, Estav Kendar, on the road south of Rennis to Boaral Keep because some sort of Letherii impropriety demanded Edur attention
[Note: Dresh Boaral had murdered his wife, Yan Tovis placed him on house arrest and requested Edur adjudication and couldn’t recall the request, she decided to execute him]
When they arrive at the keep, they’re ambushed by explosive munitions and crossbow bolts. All but one Edur are killed ☠

Stormy grabs an Edur head from the table and throws it at an Edur charging in through the door
Mayfly, having been stabbed four times, stands behind Stormy and gives him a sword
Three Edur charge at them
(Corabb)
Corabb charges the flank at of same three Edur charging Stormy
Corabb falls on the Edur that Stormy scalped and stabbed
Corabb’s spear pierces the first Edur’s thigh, severed the kneecap of a second Edur, and crashes into a floorboard plank and makes it loose and has the third Edur trip into Stormy’s sword
Cpl. Tarr arrives to block the rest of the Edur, Flashwit readies kethra knives
(Sgt. Fiddler)
Fiddler runs into the tavern through the kitchen
Sees Cpl. Tarr kill the last Edur and Corabb crawl out from under a pile of Edur corpses
Cpl. Brethless runs to the window, warns more are coming
(Sgt. Hellian)
Sgt. Hellian chooses the local Factor’s estate to bunker down
On the way with the squad holding off Edur, sees another 100 Edur down the main street
Hellian holds up the lid of an ale cask as her shield

cards.h: The Malaz 14th Army reorganized, the Bonehunters

i.html: Adjunct Tavore Paran, commander
Lostara Yil, aide Approx 8,000 soldiers The 8th Legion: Fist Keneb
3rd Company
4th Squad
Sgt. Sinter
Cpl. Pravalak Rim
Honey, sapper
Kisswhere, sapper. Sister to Sinter
Strap Mull, Dal Honese sapper
Shoaly
Lookback
5th Squad
Sgt. Badan Gruk, southern Dal Honese, looks like a Tiste Andii
Cpl. ??? (Deceased)
Ruffle
Skim
Nep Furrow, mage that speaks Jamaican patois
Reliko, smallest heavy infantry in Malazan history
Vastly Blank, Seti warrior
10th Squad
Sgt. Primly, Quon
Cpl. Hunt, Kartoolian
Mulvan Dreader, mage
Neller, Dal Honese sapper
Skulldeath, never drew blood before
Drawfirst
Sgt. Badan Gruk had lost his Corporal when he fell down an abandoned well, Ruffle was promoted to her chagrin
5th Squad, 3rd Company, 8th Legion

Badan Gruk was a Dal Honese man with pronounced epicanthic folds, hailed from the southern jungles of Dal Hon and not the northern savanna , and had skin almost as dark as Tiste Andii enough to scare even the Edur
Wields Vethbela, “Bonekisser”, a sickle sword made of ivory tusk and two small otataral blades on either side of the crescent

Blade meant to not go deep enough to preserve the prized femur bones of their enemies, to carve scenes of the owner’s death, several are presented to the threshold of a family hut when courting a lover
[Note: I’m guessing it’s a khopesh]
Sgt. Sinter was from the same tribe, Badan joined the army because of her. Sinter joined because her sister Kisswhere joined.
Badan talks to Sgt. Primly (Quon Tali) and his Cpl. Hunt (Kartool)
All of the squads have had losses, 17 total soldiers left
(Skim)
Skim turns down Honey’s flirtation attempts, both are sappers
Talk about how the sisters Sgt. Sinter and Kisswhere died from a munition explosion
Skim asks Nep Furrow to bless her two sharpers, apparently he speaks jamaican patois
(Reliko)
Reliko and Vastly Blank to have a “George and Lennie” situation going on
(Strap Mull)
Strap Mull and Neller, Dal Honese sappers, talk about how they didn’t do anything at Y’Ghatan or presently in Lether
Likes Kisswhere
Wonders if Letheras will be the same
Neller has a Letherii sword with a broken handle that howls, taken off a cabin wall
(Cpl. Pravalak Rim)
Cpl. Pravalak Rim grew up the youngest of his siblings in Gris
Lost his virginity to a 50-something Dal Honese military recruiter, had a thing for dark skinned women every since
Had a crush on Kisswhere who rejected him, though Sinter said not to give up because she could tell Kisswhere started to like him
Became suicidal after Kisswhere and Sinter died
Tribole Futan, aka Skulldeath, was 23 years old and the last surviving male of a royal line of the Gilani tribe in southeast Seven Cities
The Gilani tribe were know how having no body fat and muscles like hopes
Wielded two Gilani tulwars inherited from his uncle that was a Falah’d champion
Has a signature attack, a leaping attack (the Edged Net, lishgar efhanah) that he can do from horseback
Both men and women wanted him, lain with him so he could save himself for a queen or an empress and continue the royal Futani line
Has never spilled his seed before, never had a wet dream, Mulvan Dreader says he’s a man ready to explode
Sgt. Urb was exhausted that Hellian’s fanclub did not see everything he did to keep her alive
Urb rushes to save Sgt. Hellian from the Edur attack
6 lances attacked Hellian, 2 redirected at Urb
One of the lanced pierced Urb’s shield and impaled his arm
Urb knees impacts the cobble floor, tries to hold the ground but gets pulled by the lance
Urb gets stunned and sees white
The four lances came towards Sgt. Hellian.
Two struck the shield, one hit her helmet, one hit her right shoulder spinning her around
Hellian dives for her flask, inadvertently dodging a dozen lance attacks
A cusser detonates, blowing up the Edur and collapsing the local Factor’s estate Hellian planned to shelter in
Hellian sees an unfamiliar Kanese woman that tells her she shouldn’t be near a cusser, the Kanese woman disappears
Sgt. Urb pulled the lance from his arm and is bleeding out
Four marines enters the battle, firing their crossbows and throwing a sharper
Mulvan Dreader, a Nathii combat mage with black hair and pale skin, attends to Urb’s wounds
Mulvan hears calls for help under the collapsed estate
Inside the tavern is Fiddler, Gesler, Stormy, Bottle, Mayfly, Corabb, and Tarr
Koryk and Smiles are in the east side of the village
Several sharpers are heard outside
Fiddler takes Mayfly, Corabb, and Tarr to find who’s using munitions since they barely have any left
Outside the tavern, he finds Sgt. Badan Gruk’s squad finishing off the Edur
Badan Gruk has onyx black skin.
Ruffle is taller and has pale skin, grey eyes, and a round body
Nep Furrow, a shaman with gold piercings on his ears, nose, cheeks, and neck
Sgt. Badan Gruk explains this is their first kill
The 3rd Company were the southernmost squads that stole a fisher boat and sailed east until they hit the mouth of the Letheras River
Had their first casualties encountering a Letherii galley ship
Badan sends Ruffle with Reliko and Vastly Blank to get Sgt. Primly
Badan says they’re barely a day away from Letheras
Koryk and Smiles are cornered by 7 Edur into a street lane blocked off by stacks of timber
Smiles has no more throwing knives, only her heavy knife
They argue as the Edur spread out before them
[Skulldeath] flies in with his signature leaping attack
Flew across 4 Edur flashing his tulwars with a flurry of snicking sounds
Uses the tip of his tulwar to land softly against a slope of timbers, then launching himself to flurry against the remaining 3 Edur
Tumbles on the floor right before the opposite wall of stacked timbers, pirouettes to strike a pose as he looks on the 7 Edur he just killed
Koryk and Smiles are speechless
The newly arrived 3rd and 4th Companies of the Malaz 14th Army gather at the tavern
[Note: Sgt. Badan Gruk and squad are 3rd Company. 4th Company is never named]
Sgt. Fiddler goes over the losses they’ve suffered
Sgt. Gesler’s squad lost Sands and Uru Hela ☠
Sgt. Urb lost Hanno and Bowl ☠
, Saltlick lost his left hand
Sgt. Fiddler feels survivor’s guilt that he had no deaths
Sgt. Badan Gruk and Sgt. Primly tells Fiddler they accept him as their senior officer
Fiddler recognizes the Letherii are losing in standard military battles, the Edur are attacking in war parties using a different strategy [Note: Under Hanradi Khalag’s leadership]
Instead of facing the enemy army at Letheras, Fiddler wants to gamble and wait in this village for Fist Keneb to bring the rest of the Malaz 14th Army
Smiles tells Koryk her plan to seduce Skulldeath after seeing his leaping attack
Wants to pretend to be a Itko Kanese princess and got contraceptive herbs from Bottle
Koryk asks Bottle about the herbs. There is no contraceptive, he misunderstood Smiles

Skulldeath is a plant on Malaz Island and the Genabari Isles. There are only male, no female plants. The male Skulldeath plant spills its pollen into the air and takes over other plants when it sprouts
The Skulldeath concoction is supposed to turn gay men straight. Has no idea if it works
At the tavern, Sgt. Urb is glad no one died when the factor’s estate collapsed
Balgrid finds Sgt. Hellian hiding under the bar to report the other sergeants plan to stay in the village
Also reports another Kartool person is here
Hellian says the other Kartoolian is a spy chasing after her for the same reason she was sent away from Kartool
[Note: Hellian was in charge in Kartool when she opened the D’rek temple doors and found all of the worshipers killed inside]
Urb looks to the other end of the bar, underneath Skulldeath is also hiding from Smiles
Skulldeath’s attractive face has already broken hearts among the marines around them
The Imass women were singing in Eres’al, the First Language
Hedge was disturbed by how the language made him feel like an infant, regressing in time
Hedge and Quick Ben leave in the night and sit on long boulder against a wall of the rock enclosure that surrounds the Imass village
Quick Ben collects pebbles and flicks away ones he doesn’t need for some sort of spell
Quick Ben asks Hedge about Fiddler, knowing Hedge is able to see echoes around Fiddler
Adjunct Tavore managed to get the Bonehunters out of Malaz Harbor, despite losing Kalam, T’amber, and Quick Ben
QB believes Tavore’s retaliation against the Letherii Empire for their attacks on Malazan territory is just pretense for her own war against the Crippled God
Hedge is exhausted they’re fighting the same war as they had against the Pannion Domin
Ponders how Quick Ben was scared of Sorry who was possessed by Cotillion, and now QB is working for Cotillion
Hedge is concerned about Cotillion’s motives, since he possessed Sorry to eliminate Empress Laseen
Quick Ben demands to know if he and Hedge are fighting on the same side
With Fiddler’s echoes, Hedge answers with a cryptic maybe leaning towards yes
Hedge is frustrated that he’s been with Quick Ben from the very start of the Bridgeburners and still does not know who QB is
Hedge suspects Sorry is supposed to be with Fiddler, the same way Kalam protects Quick Ben
Hedge thinks Kellanved and Dancer had even further plans than anyone thought because they walked the path of the Azath to ascend
Quick Ben is frightened Hedge possesses knowledge, and that vicious and evil people were in the Bridgeburners when they ascended
Hedge says dying humbles you
Hedge asks how long the souls plan to hide in Quick Ben and name drops his full name, Ben Adaephon Delat, which stuns QB to silence
Over the course of the Imass women’s song, the singing changed from the complex clicks and stops of the language and simplified to something more basic and musical
The song disturbed Trull the same way it did Hedge
Hostille Rator, the T’lan Imass clan chief, speaks with Trull
The Ritual of Tellann began with passion, as does the Imass song. Passion begets a child, and when the child grows up, passion becomes nothing
A Bentract bonecaster knew the Refugium realm is a dying illusion, sacrificed herself to stop the bleeding. Now that Bonecaster’s spirit and will are failing
Hostille Rator intended to respond to the call for the Gathering, but was unable to ignore the Bonecaster’s plea
[Note: Possibly referring to Silverfox’s Gathering]
Trull openly states Hostille Rator’s intent to usurp Ulshun Pral as leader of the Bentract Imass and end the illusion, but is stopped by Rud Elalle’s presence
The Imass women stop singing, everyone is looking at them
Onrack and Rud Elalle step forward
Hostille and the two Bentract Bonecasters firmly believe the realm is dying, that they will lose their flesh once they leave
Hostille reveals Onrack’s intent to die in this realm defending it
Trull says he surrenders his life to stand with Onrack because they are bonded by friendship
Onrack cannot reject Trull, accepting that he will never be at peace
Hostille and the Bonecasters kneel before Rud Elalle, humbled by Trull and Onrack’s bond, and requests to be accepted as Rud’s soldiers
Rud Elalle accepts, but only welcomes them as friends
Onrack puts a hand on Trull’s shoulders and say this realm will never die, and if they are careful neither will they die
Quick Ben tells Hedge the confrontation was averted as long as neither of them picked up a dropped fang
QB is certain Scabandari Bloodeye’s Finnest is here in the Refugium
Seren Pedac’s group arrives at a 5-story tall arched Gate made of stone blocks, some piece flung a hundred steps away
Seren looks at the condition of her party
Udinaas and Seren were exhausted. Silchas Ruin and Clip looked impervious. Kettle had the unlimited energy of a child though she might suddenly collapse.
Fear is exhausted, but Seren thinks his vow weighs heavily on his mind
Seren is tired of Fear guarding her on behalf of his dead brother’s marriage proposal, despite thinking how much of an ugly and awful person she is
Ponders on how primitive cultures have a divide between men and women, men would possess women in a matter of ownership and have survival in a sense of power
The Letherii culture as least was not divided by gender
Only very few tribes on Lether were matriarchies
Udinaas asks Clip about what attacked the gate and says he wishes he’d garrote himself with his chain
Seren realizes that Clip is actually an assassin
As they walk forward, everyone prepares their weapons and walks into the Gate
Black volcanic ash, a vast black sky, three suns blazing in the sky, rough plain. Hundreds of dead dragons
The group have passed from the Tiste Realm to Starvald Demelain

cards.h: Scene 1 (Letherii Camp near Q’uson Tapi, Gaskaral Traum)

i.html: Gaskaral Traum, a Letherii with faint Tarthenal blood, is Bivatt’s bodyguard for Brohl Handar having eliminated 7 in total
The day before battle, Gaskaral stops the seventh assassin from killing Brohl
Gaskaral set up his tent 40 steps away from the Edur camp
At dawn, he slips outside the tent and waits for a would be assassin to approach Brohl
As the assassin stabs down, Gaskaral lunges and stabs the assassin through the rib cage into their heart, killing them
Brohl remained asleep
Gaskaral carries the assassin’s corpse over the shoulder, planning to hide it in his tent and dispose of it during tomorrow’s battle
Two assassins attack Gaskaral, he’s less alert due to fatigue
Threw the corpse at the right-side assassin, the assassin falls
Charges the left assassin, thwarts the dagger aiming for his throat, and snaps the assassin’s neck
Kicks the right assassin in the chin hard enough to sever the brain stem
Gaskaral is disappointed he has more bodies to hide and dispose
Brohl Handar wakes up fully rested and has no idea someone saved his life
Gaskaral Traum offers to escort Brohl to meet with Atri-Preda Bivatt without telling his name or revealing his mission
Brohl thinks he’s more like gentle horse-handler than a soldier
Brohl meets with Bivatt
The sun rises and bakes the top layer of the Q’uson Tapi seabed, enough for it to be steaming
The Bluerose Battalion has less than 1000 soldiers, struggles with their new swords and shields, and are expected to be back up only
Doesn’t believe the Awl preparations is enough to stay dry and provide solid footing on the mud
Letherii sawtooth formation
Three wedges of heavy infantry at the front line
Flanks of medium infantry and archers
Between the wedges are groups of archers to punch holes into the Awl line opening opportunities for the heavy front line to breach
Two mages remain and stand at each end of the heavy frontline to angle and maximize the most destruction
Three mages, and fourth succumbing to their injuries, were killed by an archer and one arrow
[Note: Toc-Anaster hype]
Gaskaral Traum whispers his report to Bivatt which gives her a shocked face
Toc watches children playing as he writes or paints something, then predicts how the Awl formation will fall apart traversing through the mud
Torment continues to antagonize Toc
Toc wonders why the K’Chain Che’Malle obey Redmask
Toc compares Torment’s blind faith in Redmask as Toc’s horse does to his rider
The Letherii/Edur mages are seen moving to the shoreline
Lookback, Drawfirst, and Shoaly are Falari heavies that also have ancestry from the indigenous Walk people
The Walk people are short, black haired, and have olive skin
Dominated the Falari isles with bronze weapons and items before the iron age
Had mines of tin, copper, and lead
Lookback thinks Sgt. Gesler and Cpl. Stormy should die for betraying Fener’s cult
Shoaly respects them for survived Y’Ghatan, have the last Bridgerburner, and were high ranked as Old Guard like Whiskeyjack before being demoted
Argues its not their fault for Fener’s decline
Drawfirst says she and Shoaly are willing to stand alongside and die with them
An hour before sunrise, Beak and Cpt. Faradan Sort walk up to report to Fist Keneb
The Tiste Edur ahead had retreated from the town the marines are hiding in
Beak notes the interesting mages
Bottle. An old style warlock of the Jakata people, the first people on Malaz Island after the Stormriders retreated
Nep Furrow. Dal Honese bush shaman
???. Dal Honese Grass Dancer
[Note: I have no clue who this could be, it might just be apart of Nep Furrow’s abilities]
Mulvan Dreader. Nathii swamp necromancer
Affirms that Sgt. Fidder, Sgt. Gesler, and Cpl. Stormy are in the village
Gesler and Stormy had skin and muscles of gold. Their bodies were reforged in the same fires of Tellann, Telas, and Kurald Liosan as dragons fly through to gain immunities and proofs against magic
Fist Keneb orders both of them go into the village
Beak and Cpt. Sort walk past the pits of dead Tiste Edur
Beak says almost a thousand Edur were about to attack the Malazan squads, but retreated. There will be about four to five thousand by the time Adjunct Tavore’s fleet catches up with them
Cpl. Tarr meets Cpt. Sort and Beak at the village edge and reports they’re at the tavern
(Bottle)
Bottle struggles to control an owl no matter how much he grips its little soul
Sees thousands of figures moving quietly half a league (mile and a half, 30 minute walk) away behind Fist Keneb’s column
Nep Furrow pulls up a chair to sit down in front of Bottle
Nep says Bottle is used up and the Tanno Spiritwalker’s song on Fiddler’s instrument is not done yet
Sgt. Fiddler approaches and says get ready to go outside
(Koryk)
Koryk is excited to kill Edur, Sgt. Fiddler is slapping everyone’s helmets to wake them up
Fist Keneb arrives with Sgt. Thom Tissy, Cpt. Sort, and Beak
Keneb calls all of the sergeants up. Fiddler, Gesler, Hellian, Urb, Badan Gruk, Primly
Fist Keneb congratulates everyone on doing a good job, but serious work begins now
Sgt. Gesler is concerned about being outnumbered beyond what they can handle, 10 to 1 or even worse than that
Sgt. Fiddler is concerned that their mages are used up, especially Bottle.
Fiddler yells at Beak for smiling
Cpt. Sort stands up for Beak, Beak says everyone here is his friend and friends are the most important thing in the world
Fiddler gets nervous and looks away, sees the sun is rising
Fist Keneb orders to form up for march and they will alternate double time speeds every 100 steps
(Corabb)
Corabb collects a bunch of weapons and looks forward to dying a glorious death as he should’ve during the Whirlwind Rebellion
Has x4 spears, x2 javelins, a scimitar, a Letherii longsword, x2 sticker knives, and brace of gutting knives, a Letherii shield, a crossbow with x27 quarrels, and a sharper
Hopes people will tell tales about the one them, that their bones will be hunted and sold on the market for their magical properties, and his larger than average skull would sell for more
Cuttle complains that he has to dodge all of Corabb’s weapons while marching behind him
(Sgt. Hellian)
Sgt. Hellian is still either drink or severely hungover
Doesn’t want to be Skulldeath’s queen, but would sleep with him
Sgt. Urb won’t come close to Hellian after Skulldeath announced he gave his heart to her
The Cpl. Touchy Brethless twins try to get Hellian’s attention to look at the thousands of the enemies on the rise above
(Sirryn Kanar)
Sirryn Kanar speaks to an unnamed Letherii commander as they look down upon the Malazan army below them
Surprised to find that there’s less than a thousand Malazans
Though talented the Malazans are outnumbered, their sorcery was only good for hiding them and now they’re exposed in the open
They see the Malazan army form a defensive circle as if they are making a last stand here
Toc’s missing eye itches reacting to the Letherii mages
A circle of soldiers wielding oversized shields protect the mages as they prepare their ritual to crash their waves of sorcery into the Awl line
30 steps away from the mages, the K’Chain Che’Malle had buried themselves under the lake bed, Redmask guessed where the optimal position for the mages would be
The KCCM erupts from the ground. The Battle of Q’uson Tapi begins
Sag’Churok’s blades turns the first Letherii mage into a mist of blood and meat
Gunth Mach leaps and crushes the second mage
The Letherii wedges march forward and descend into the lakebed, falling knee deep into the mud and eventually stopped moving completely
The Letherii horns would play a new song, the army resumes their march guided by the rhythm of the horns
(Natarkas)
Redmask instructed Natarkas to lead 2000 warriors in the night to position themselves a mile behind the Letherii army and charge when the battle has lasted two hours
If they are discovered before their time, Redmask wants them to hold to keep the enemy distracted. If the enemy chased, Natarkas would lead the Awl away but not attack
The enemy had seen Natarkas. Natarkas chooses to disobey both the instruction to wait or flee, pride wins out
(Brohl Handar)
Brohl Handar readies the Edur’s spearmen against Natarkas’s charge and sends a runner for Bivatt to have the Bluerose lancers ready for a flank charge
(Horses)
As Natarkas screams his orders, he gets impaled through the head by a spear and falls off his horse. Natarkas dies ☠
Natarkas’ horse flees with two other riderless horses, exclaiming their freedom
(The Awl, a very terrifying POV)
The Awl fire arrows, but they watch as the Letherii army march ceaselessly without mercy
The Letherii frontlines die, their corpses push and roll providing footholds for the soldiers behind them
Step by slow unforgiving step, the Awl watched the unstoppable waves of corpses, spears, and shields roll towards them until they reach the Awl
Sgt. Fiddler is ready to die fighting, expects to die from sorcery
The soldiers are digging holes to take cover when their satchel of munitions including two cussers detonates
Cuttle sees the Tiste Edur leader and plans to take him out with a cusser
A messenger from Fist Keneb tells Fiddler to maintain their turtleback defense formation and not engage the enemy, not saying how long
Swirling magic of dark purple and crimson veins and black lightning rose higher and higher
Fiddler realizes the Letherii are betraying the Tiste Edur, using the battle with the Malazans as their excuse to kill all of them
The Eres’al has not been with Bottle since they landed on Lether, she can’t help them
Hanradi Khalag look at the wall of Letherii sorcery whose size required weeks of preparation, understands the Edur have been betrayed
Two K’risnan warlocks step forward to answer Hanradi’s call, they announce they’ve been abandoned by Kurald Emurlahn and Chaos, losing their magic
Hanradi kills one of the warlocks, chopping at their eyes and stabbing their throat
The other warlock points towards the Malazans where a dome of silver light pulsed and grew around them claiming it’s Father Shadow’s power
Hanradi calls to advance on the Malazans to at least hide in the dome’s shadow
Beak recalls on a hot summer day when he was playing with his wax figures of the villagers in an abandoned barn
Beak’s older brother came after fighting with their mother, half smiling told Beak to take his toys and leave
The brother hangs himself, Beak tries to hold his brother up but the brother dies
Beak stays there until three hours after dark when the stable hand and villagers find them in the barn
Beak lights all of his candles to protect his friends from the sorcery that seven Letherii lost control of
Believes purification is not achieved by offerings or self flagellation, but by understanding that it is final
Inside the opaque silver dome of light, Fiddler looks around and could see inside the bodies of his soldiers
Koryk, Smiles, and Cuttle all had damages shown in their bones
Corabb had a power inside him that continues to destroy the cancers and disease that are sieging his body
Bottle holds coruscating waves of power that’s beyond control
Cpl. Tarr has a light emanating as strong as silver
Sgt. Gesler and Cpl. Stormy were lit in gold fire, even their beards were spun in gold
Fiddler steps outside the dome to see hundreds of Edur crouched, waiting to die
Hanradi looks up as the wall of Letherii sorcery covers half the sky and begins to fall on them
Hanradi looks down at Fiddler, appearing an an apparition of white, his uniform and weapons looks clean, polished, pristine
Fiddler looks at them with his silver eyes and waves them forward
Hanradi tosses his weapon away and moved foreword, his soldiers did the same. The Edur surrender
The soldiers walked toward the light as the dome came close to protect them
A K’risnan warlock bursts into flames, leaving only ashes behind
Beak feels happy to save his friends
He understands an old sergeant, a twisted old mage that could not embrace purification after surrendering too much of his soul
The others, filled with bitterness needed to be swept away
The wall of Letherii sorcery falls on them
The Letherii commander standing next to Sirryn Kanar could only see the wall of dark storm and hissing clouds fall onto the Edur and Malazans
The seven mages were pulled from the ground, up into the storm and torn apart in streaks of whipping blood
The shockwave of the sorcery knock over the Letherii soldiers, some being crushed by their own horses
The ridge collapses in a landslide falling to the killing field below
Beak burns inside from lighting all of his candles and opening all of his warrens
Remembers how he loves his friends, seeing them smile and laugh with him, grabbing his shoulders and tousling his hair
Wants to kiss Cpt. Faradan Sort, even wishing to do something more brave
His sensation of pain is scoured away
The Letherii commander watches as the dark storm is fragmented and crashes around Beak’s dome, ripping into the earth as black clouds. Clouds of white corkscrew into the air and dissipate
The Malazans had held and survived
A runner informs that Malazans have arrived with a score of warships on the beach [Note: Adjunct Tavore’s fleet]
The commander orders to leave the Malazans below for the Edur to deal with, his army will face the Malazan fleet
(Cpt. Faradan Sort)
As Beak’s dome dissipates, Cpt. Faradan Sort looks around and sees white everywhere
Armor and weapons glowed. Soldiers’ hair turned white. Battle scars on their faces healed.
Grass grew wildly from the earth below
Sort looks at the remains of Beak, ashes and scorched bone, like a child hiding in a closet holding himself in fetal position
Beak dies ☠
(Fiddler)
Sgt. Fiddler speaks to Hanradi Khalag and allows them to leave. He’s not here to commit genocide
Hanradi leaves, leading the Edur home to their villages and families to the far north
Hanradi answers that the Emperor cannot be killed
Sgt. Gesler suggests they arrive to Letheras before Adjunct Tavore does
Fiddler wonders why they’ve all turned white, Gesler shows off his golden hair which annoys Fiddler
Hood helps Beak stand up, as they are before Hood’s Gate
Hood’s hand was skeletal with a strange hue of green skin. He was tall and wore black rags
The entrance to Hood’s Gate is white. The gate is made of white marble, inside was swirling silver light
Hood is waiting for another person
Beak’s brother waits for him inside, but will not know Beak
Beak asks if he can save his brother now that he’s bigger and stronger. Hood agrees
Beak walks in to see his brother surrounded by wax figures of the villagers
Beak tears up, asking to play with him, and sits down with his brother
Hood waits
Friend?
(Atri-Preda Bivatt)
Bivatt watches as the Letherii and Awl kill each other in a seething mass of mud and blood
To the west, the K’Chain Che’Malle were slaughtering the Letherii until both were driven back by arrows and a spear lodged in the female’s left thigh
Bivatt wanted to send the Bluerose after the KCCM, but they disappeared to the northeast [Note: To kill Natarkas and his ambush unit]
The KCCM went to the eastern side of the battlefield
Bivatt orders her remaining 200 spearmen to defend the east flank
Bivatt had seen Redmask abandon his command post to defend a breach half an hour ago and had not been sighted since
Instead of feeling victorious, she hates the Awl for not fleeing. A third of her army is dead
(Brohl Handar)

Brohl gets literally bloodthirsty as he stabs an Awl in her belly, drinks her blood which feels like honey coating his throat, is aware he’s gone crazy, and leads his Edur to enthusiastically kill more Awl
Masarch tries to cover his flank from bleeding and looks around for Redmask, blaming him for the Awl’s defeat
A Letherii soldier charges with a scream and impales Masarch through the chest into the wood with his sword
Masarch thinks the Letherii is saying something vile and hateful as Masarch dies ☠
