Quick Ben senses something is wrong
They go inside the building and see the stairs up
Quick Ben panics and has them run inside
(Fiddler)
As Silchas opens his mouth, Fiddler fires a munition that detonates as Silchas attempts to deflect it with his hind leg
The marines all are knocked down as the roof starts to crumble
Silchas’ chest has an wound torn open and his wings are torn. Silchas falls towards the street
Another munition is fired, Silchas falls into a building
The building the marines are on starts falling, Fiddler turns and sees Hedge and Quick Ben running towards them
Quick Ben runs to the edge of the roof and raises his hands
Silchas flies into the air using sorcery
Quick Ben casts waves of crackling fire repeatedly on Silchas until Silchas flies away
Quick Ben falls to his knees
Hedge says he’s not a ghost, Fiddler asks Quick Ben where he’s been
(Bottle)
Bottle looks over, doesn’t know Hedge but recognizes him as a Bridgeburner sapper
Bottle watched as Silchas flies away
(Seren Pedac)
Seren Pedac and Trull had lain together on their cloaks in Seren’s empty looted house
Trull picks up the Imass spear and leaves
Though Seren doesn’t want him to, she asks him to come back
I will. I can do nothing else. You have all there is of me, all that’s left.’
‘Then I have all I need.’
(Trull Sengar)
Trull heads towards the Eternal Domicile
The Errant watches him from the shadows
Brys catches up with Tehol, having an Elder God as a manservant and two different colored eyes
A crowd makes noise outside the compound, Bugg explains the rat catchers Ormly and Rucket have spent a lot of money on criers that make Tehol the hero
Tehol wants to see Janath
Lostara Yil watches a Letherii garrison officer formally surrender to Adjunct Tavore
Tavore leads her cavalry and Fist Keneb’s 500 surviving marines towards the Eternal Domicile
Fist Blistig remains in charge of the main army
Sinn laughs as she watches Silchas Ruin repelled by Fiddler’s munitions and Quick Ben’s sorcery
Lostara wonders if it was a good idea to let frenzied bloodthirsty marines storm the capital first before them
Tavore marches her forced at a steady, unhurried pace as citizens watch them, some even welcoming them
Lostara thinks the arrival of the Malaz army gives the citizens hope that peace and order will return, though she is wary they could turn at any second
Ahead of the Malaz army, the Letherii are chanting ‘Saviour’ and a proclamation of a new ‘Emperor’
Tavore halts the Malaz army
Rucket, with Ormly standing by, presents Brys Beddict as Champion of the previous king and Saviour as well as Tehol Beddict the new Emperor of Lether
Brys offers to escort the Malazans to the palace to expel Emperor Rhulad, assuming that they come as liberators
Tavore asks if he is implying her forces are not enough to occupy Letheras. Asks about the Bolkando Alliance that thwarted the eastern Letherii armies and march on Letheras
Brys asks if they come as conquerors, Tavore just mutters Hood forbid and notes Tehol seems shy
Tehol explains he is surprised Rucket said he was only half good in bed
Sirryn Kanar abandons his men to Fiddler’s slaughter in the Eternal Domicile
Thinks Chancellor Triban Gnol is still at the arena and heads there where he thinks he will survive in Triban’s shadow
Triban Gnol starts to realize Rhulad has finally died for the final time, gives thanks to Karsa for ending him
Triban orders Finadd Varat Taun to escort him to the Eternal Domicile to await the conquering Malazans and to bring Samar Dev and ask her what she did by offering her blood
Triban noticed how Varat Taun was gentle in bringing Samar Dev, and not pressing with the authority of his office. Triban distrusts him and would rather have Sirryn Kanar
Triban wishes he could spit in Rhulad’s dead face
Cuttle leads Sgt. Fiddler towards the direction of where the people fleeing from them are running to, assumes they are heading to the throne room
Fiddler let his squad be bloodthirsty and kill the Letherii, though Quick Ben looked disapprovingly on it
Fiddler never saw Quick Ben unleash that much sorcery before, wonders where all the magic came from
Fiddler still can’t believe Hedge is alive and slaps him on the head just to make sure
Hedge reminds him he was the ghost that helped him at Y’Ghatan and that Fiddler’s new white hair and beard makes him look old
A group of Letherii appear from a side door in the corridor and a fight starts
Cpl. Tarr headshots Chancellor Triban Gnol and spills his brain on the floor, two other quarrels fire into him making him spin before falling down
Two Letherii guards are struck by quarrels, Corabb charges forward bumping into Tarr
The guards throw down their weapons
Quick Ben runs in front and shoves Corabb to the side, shouting that the Letherii surrendering and demanding they stop killing everyone
A woman [Note: Samar Dev] calls out in Malazan that they surrender and begs not to kill them.
Another officer says the Emperor lies dead in the arena.
[Note: I think this is Finadd Varat Taun. Makes sense he speaks Malazan since he did travel around Malazan territory gathering champions]
Sgt. Fiddler has them taken prisoner and to lead them to the arena
Smiles runs forward to chop off Triban Gnol’s hands after trying to pull off his rings, snarls at Fiddler when he yells at her
(Trull Sengar)
Trull walks towards Rhulad lying in the arena
Trull tried looking for his parents, believed they abandoned Rhulad and left with the rest of the Tiste Edur home
Sees Rhulad’s arm and cursed sword missing, Trull holds a dead brother’s head in his lap for the second time
Trull had forgiven Rhulad for Shorning him and wonders if he would do the same but its too late to have an answer
After all this tragedy, Trull feels like his life is about to start over and bloom with Seren’s love
A knife is suddenly thrust through his left shoulder blade into his heart. Rhulad’s head falls out of his hands. As he asks for Seren’s forgiveness, Trull Sengar dies ☠
(Sirryn Kanar)
Sirryn Kanar murders the last Tiste Edur, believing he has delivered justice to his Empire.
The sun was at its highest point, Sirryn Kanar’s shadow would not warn Trull
The barbarian dies, for mine is the hand of civilization
Others enter the arena, a quarrel pierces Sirryn’s shoulder causing him to spin and trip over Trull and Rhulad’s corpses
Hedge moans ‘No’ as he runs to Trull, Quick Ben follows after him
Hedge pushes past Koryk who shot at Sirryn, Koryk turns with an expression that wonders if he fucked up
Cuttle notes the coins burned into Rhulad’s body, [Note: Varat Taun] affirms he was their emperor
Fiddler orders the hostages to stand by the wall and for his marines to form a defense
Fiddler goes up to Hedge, feels lost seeing Hedge raw with anguish
Quick Ben looks at Sirryn Kanar and says he’ll survive
Hedge rasps ‘No he won’t’ in a manner that sounds unhuman. They look at each other in silent agreement.
Hedge asks Quick Ben if he can send Trull’s murderer to a place of eternal torment
Quick Ben looks to Fiddler for reassurance, even QB is grieving
Fiddler gives him permission as he is a High Mage
Quick Ben tells Hedge that Hood owes him
Sirryn Kanar is engulfed in a dark blur, he screams as he sinks down into the sand and nothing is left behind
Sirryn Kanar dies ☠
Enraged, Quick Ben pulls Fiddler over and demands he feels no pity for Trull’s murderer
Fiddler agrees, feeling helpless as he watches Hedge weep while holding Trull’s body
The Errant watches from afar
From the small POV it seems he’s regretful and suicidal but can’t help being what he is. A tipper of balances and maker of widows. The Errant’s nudge killed Trull
As Karsa walks up the Crippled God’s beach, he grabs the cursed sword by the bladed edge and pulls it out of his thigh
Karsa walks over to the hut on the grass, drops the cursed sword, and with one hand lifts up the hut and tosses it upside down
The Crippled God is revealed, sitting cross legged by his brazier of smoking coals
Rhulad, appearing so young, is washed up on the sands and shrieks awake
The Cripple God cries out to Rhulad to take the sword, begs that his brother is alive and looking for him in the palace, that he must get the sword and return to life and ask his forgiveness
Karsa tells Rhulad not to. He will kill him here and finally give Rhulad his end
Rhulad crawls to the sword and reaches for it, Karsa feels regret as he decapitates the boy
Rhulad Sengar dies ☠
The Cripple God laughs as he offers the cursed sword to Karsa, as if it was made for him who can withstand the curse
No one chooses me. I do not give anyone that right. I am Karsa Orlong of the Teblor. All choices belong to me.
The Crippled God offers immortality, opens a portal of fire to return to his homeland as Emperor, to guide and save the Teblor on a campaign to slaughter children
Karsa Orlong walks away
A man with three bhokorala walk forward
Withal appears on the Crippled God’s beach to break the cursed sword
[Note: Not sure how he got here]
Withal had lied to the Crippled God that it was indestructible
Karsa slaps Withal for forging the cursed sword and tells him not to do it again
Karsa walks off into the portal of fire that the Crippled God had opened and it closes
Withal admits he drank a lot before coming, drunkenly reaches for the cursed sword
Recalled an old smith’s secret
To break an aspected weapon, bring it home, to the forge where it was born
Orders the nachts to bring the boat around
Withal breaks the cursed sword on the anvil he forged it as the Crippled God cries out to the sky
(Nimander Golit)
Nimander wakes up hearing the sound of Clip’s spinning chain. He runs downstairs to the streets of a squalid town
Clip emerges from the darkness, greets Nimander by his name and recognizes they’re on the Isle of the Shake. A people of mixed Andii ancestry who will never be ready
Clip wants to take Nimander and his kin to Anomander Rake
Clip claims to be Mother Dark’s Herald. It does not matter what anyone of them want
Nimander still thinks he’s in a nightmare, Clip says he would’ve done the same because Phaed was insane and dangerous
Nimander thinks their exile ends with Mother Dark herself summoning them
(Clip)
Clip speaks to himself, wants to get revenge on Anomander for his perceived betrayal of walking away from “them”
(Rud Elalle)
Rud Elalle sits with Udinaas on a boulder at the edge of a village, watching a stranded ranag calf
Rud wants to eat it, Udinaas thinks killing the calf is heartless
Because of Seren “raping” his mind in the past, Udinaas knows Seren is grieving Trull’s death
Udinaas told Onrack about Trull’s death despite it only hurting him
Rud asks how long Udinaas is staying, he replies until Rud tosses him out
Rud cries tears of joy knowing his father is staying with him
Udinaas feels like he can teach him nothing as an ex-slave and mender of nets, Rud says he can teach him the greatest skill which is to survive
The ranag calf walks off and the two go back to the village
(Onrack)
Onrack decides to leave his wife Kilava Onass to find Trull’s body and tell Seren Pedac of his journey with Trull
Kilava decides to join him, they both go to hug their say and say goodbye to their son Ulshun Pral
Three weeks have past since Tehol Beddict became emperor, he is exhausted doing nothing and Brys says there’s peace in the land
Adjunct Tavore and Shurq Elalle are planning to talk to Tehol
The new Chancellor Janath Anarr arrives, they debate whether she should be also be considered First Concubine and Empress
Tehol suggests Ublala Pung as a new Finadd to help Preda Varat Taun’s reconstruction effort for Letheras
Bugg is exasperated and goes for a walk
Seren Pedac is exhaustively picking up the pavestones at the entrance to her house using an iron bar as a lever
The center stone is giving her difficulty and she can’t move it
An old man with wrists of a mason comes and offers to help with the center stone
Bugg bends the iron bar as he tries to use it for leverage
Bugg cusses to himself, then digs his fingers into the stone block and moves it to the side, then telling her to hire other men when she needs to put it back
Seren is confused how he knows
Bugg leaves, then comes back saying he learned about Seren after talking to the Errant
Bugg tells her to cherish all she has left of him and walks away
Seren places her hand on her stomach and realizes she is pregnant
Ultra Condensed Summaries

Redmask, an exiled commander of the Awl, had come to the aftermath of the battle between Drene and the Grey Swords of Elingarth. The Awl under Hadralt’s leadership had betrayed pact he had with the Grey Swords and abandoned them, leading their massacre at the hands of the Letherii.
Atri-Preda Bivatt and Brohl Handar, the new Overseer/Governor of Drene, continue the massacres of the Awl
Atri-Preda Bivatt of the Drene garrison was a talented commander expected to become the next Preda.

Factor Letur Anict uses the false pretense that the Awl have formed a Bolkando Alliance with other tribes (D’rashilhani, Ak’ryn, Bolkando, and Saphinaud) to threaten the eastern front of the Letherii Empire. This war is profitable for Letur Anict.
Redmask returns to the Awl with two K’Chain Che’Malle, Sag’Churok and Gunth Mach that follow him without knowing why

Redmask goes to the Ganetok camp and exposes the leader Hadralt for poisoning his father, abandoning his pact with the Grey Swords, and that he was bribed by the Letherii to give his own people inferior weapons so that they would be slaughtered in exchange for money, property, and indebted slaves
Hadralt is killed by his own clan members and Redmask becomes the leader of the Ganetok, as well as the remaining Awl clans
Redmask meets with Toc-Anaster, survivor of the Grey Swords and prisoner of Hadralt.
Battle of Bast Fulmar
Redmask knew that magic is dead in the region because it was the site of the Tellann Ritual which killed magic in the land
Despite facing disadvantages, Atri-Preda Bivatt commits to the battle and the Letherii are defeated
Battle of Pradegar
Not having a way to actually counter the mages, Redmask relies on unpredictability and attacks the Letherii at night.
The Awl were defeated, losing thousands of warriors compared to hundreds of Letherii and Edur
The Letherii now pursue the Awl
Battle of Q’uson Tapi
Redmask sets up for a final confrontation on a muddy bed of a dead lake that had long dried up
Despite having the K’Chain Che’Malle set up to slaughter the mages, the Awl were defeated
Sensing Redmask having lost, the K’Chain Che’Malle kill Redmask and leave the battlefield
Toc has Torrent, a young Awl warrior, lead the Awl children towards and unknown army on the horizon and gives him his satchel of poems
Toc dies defending the children as they escape

cards.h: Onos Toolan and the Whiteface Barghast

i.html: The Whiteface Barghast has sailed on their war canoes from Genabackis to Lether. Their purpose is not yet revealed in Reaper’s Gale, only mentioned that the journey that awaits them lies to the east.
The reason they stayed behind is to get revenge on the Awl for betraying the Grey Swords, believing that Toc is dead because of them
Humbrall Taur passed away when the Barghast landed on Lether, Tool married Hetan and became the leader of the Whiteface Barghast
At the Battle of Q’uson Tapi, Tool concealed the Barghast in the Tellann warren, waiting to slaughter both the Awl for their betrayal and the Letherii
When Torrent delivered Toc’s satchel of poems, Tool, Hetan, and Kilava Onass realized they just witnessed Toc the Younger’s death before their eyes
Tool weeps as he holds Toc’s dead body, the Whiteface Barghast move to slaughter the Awl and Letherii
Bivatt and Brohl Handar bid each other to die well
Karos Invictad and Tanal Yathvanar lead the fascist police, the Patriotists.
Tanal had kidnapped a scholar that he repeatedly rapes, Janath Anarr
When money is short, Karos needed to be careful with influential families and ordered Janath be released. Tanal instead hid her in a torture chamber
Tehol Beddict and Bugg orchestrate the financial collapse of the Letherii Empire by taking out loans to pay for other loans
Was assisted by the Rat Catcher’s Guild, a secret group of assassins and thieves
While Bugg was surveying the city for his construction company, he found Janath’s torture chamber. He blocks out her traumatic memories and takes her to Tehol’s Residence

The Patriotists raid Tehol’s Residence while Bugg is away, arrest Tehol and Janath and they both are tortured. Bugg attempts to phase through the city in his god form but gets caught by the Errant’s trap
Brys Beddict is revived by Bruthen Trana, traveling the ocean’s depths to the Place of Names and calling his name
Ormly, Champion of the Rat Catcher’s Guild, bribes people to yell out that Tehol is a revolutionary hero that will save the Empire
Ormly goes to Settle Lake with one of Brys’ severed fingers [unknown how the Rat Catcher’s Guild obtained it] where Brys Beddict surfaces
Bugg is released when Icarium’s machine turns on and breaks the city.
Brys Beddict goes to the Patriotist Compound and kills Karos Invictad, freeing his brother
Janath chokes Tanal Yathvanar to death with his train, presumably is freed by Brys and Tehol
The people have chosen Tehol Beddict as their new Emperor, Rucket presents him as such when meeting Adjunct Tavore
Udinaas, Seren Pedac, Silchas Ruin, Fear Sengar, Wither, and Kettle all flee Letheras in search of Scabandari Bloodeye’s Finnest

They travel through the Bluerose Mountains, killing all the Letherii that hunt them down and Letherii garrisons that inadvertently cut off the supply line to the Drene garrison, weakening them against the Awl
They explore K’Chain Che’Malle skykeeps, get lore drops about the Nah’ruk (Short Tails) and Che’Malle (Long Tails)
Clip of the Bluerose Tiste Andii meets the party and takes them to Andara to meet with the Onyx Wizard cult who worships Anomander Rake.

Gothos’ Omtose Phellack had frozen the land. Now that the ice is failing, the glaciers atop the mountain hold a spear aimed at Andara and tasks Clip to escort Silchas Ruin to find Scabandari’s soul and change the trajectory of the spear
Menandore is able to see through Udinaas’ mind and enter his dreams after raping him in the past and track his progress while also giving him information he shouldn’t have

After Orbyn Truthfinder leads the Patriotists to massacre the Bluerose Tiste Andii of Andara, their blood is the cost for Clip to open the Gate to the elemental Tiste realm which leads them to Starvald Demelain
Passing through mounds of dead dragons, they come to the Gate that leads to a cave in the Refugium

Immediately passing through the Gate, Trull Sengar and Onrack are on the other side. Fear attacks Silchas in attempt to protect his brother, but is killed by Clip. Trull KO’s Clip, but is crippled by Silchas’ chopping into his hip.
Seren Pedac throws an Imass spear at Wither killing him, protecting Udinaas

Gothos had left Scabandari’s Finnest in the form of a flint dagger in Ulshun Pral’s care. Silchas takes the flint dagger and buries it into Kettle’s heart (which was an Azath seed), sealing the Twelve Gates of Starvald Demelain inside a reborn Azath Tower
Udinaas remains with his son Rud Elalle in the Refugium

Using the gates within the Azath Tower, Seren Pedac is able to return to her home in Letheras with Trull. They share a bed together before Trull leaves to find his brother Rhula and is killed in the Arena.
Seren Pedac mourns Trull’s loss, but is visited by Bugg who knows she’s pregnant with Trull’s child.
Silchas Ruin flies back to Letheras in dragon form to punish Hannan Mosag and the Crippled God, but instead gets his ass kicked by Quick Ben and disappears.

cards.h: The Malaz 14th Army, the Bonehunters pt. 1

i.html: After the Bonehunters fled from Malaz City, Lostara Yil stepped up to be Adjunct Tavore’s aide and second in command
Banaschar’s treasure hoard from investigating the slaughtered D’rek temples were confiscated as funds for the army
Adjunct Tavore declares that the Bonehunters’ goal is to deliver vengeance on the Letherii Empire for their genocide of the isle of Sepik, a protectorate of the Malazan Empire
Upon arriving to Lether, Tavore had their transport ships burned at sea

Withal and Sandalath were rescued from the Crippled God by Mael, who left them to live on Malaz City and wait until someone came to pick them up, Adjunct Tavore. During their voyage to Lether, they had meetings together where Tavore learned all she could about the Crippled God and the cursed sword that binds Emperor Rhulad
Sgt. Balm and Sgt. Cord made first contact on Second Maiden Fort with Shake Brullyg to make a deal with him.
In exchange for being their guests, Sinn will hold back the sheets of ice released from Gothos’ Omtose Phellack sorcery expiring
Fist Keneb leads his platoon to invade the Letherii Coast

After burning the transport ships, the marine squads were scattered across the coast to fight against the Tiste Edur, find allies among the oppressed Letherii, and spark a civil war in the Letherii Empire
Fist Keneb sends Cpt. Faradan Sort and squad mage Beak to go find and organize their scattered squads

Shurq Elalle became the pirate captain of the Undying Gratitude. They delivered the Crimson Guard to Jacuruku, then finds an Edur ship destroyed by Fist Keneb’s forces. They loot the ship and plan to sell it in Letheras.
The crew is forced to land on Second Maiden Fort as mountains of ice resulting from Gothos’ Omtose Phellack sorcery was melting

Shurq Elalle goes straight to the harbormaster, Shake Brullyg to negotiate with him. However, she has to wait several days until she gets the opportunity to deliver a cask of ale from a tavern to Shake’s estate.
Shurq meets with the Bonehunters occupying Shake Brullyg’s estate and gets swept up in their invasion of Letheras.
Shurq speaks to Adjunct Tavore and informs her about the present state of Lether. The Edur rule in ignorance. The marines will not find allies among the Letherii because they are the ones in control.
Cpt. Faradan Sort and Beak catch up to Sgt. Hellian and Sgt. Urb’s squads
Sgt. Hellian went too far ahead from the rest of the Malazan Army and killed too many Edur and Letherii that the enemy has become suspicious and bolstered their numbers
Sgt. Urb is aware that the Letherii don’t want to be liberated, Cpt. Sort agrees with Sgt. Hellian that they should commit to a fast and vicious campaign
Sgt. Fiddler and Sgt. Gesler continue their campaign across the Letherii countryside, fighting enemy Edur, Letherii, and even demon prince farmers

cards.h: The Malaz 14th Army, the Bonehunters pt. 2

i.html: After getting information, Adjunct Tavore departs from Second Maiden Fort with the main army and sets sail towards Letheras
Shurq Elalle is taken with them, the Drift Avalii Tiste Andii children and the Shake are left behind

Sgt. Hellian’s tavern-to-tavern strategy provided success, learning that they should aim to liberate the Indebted Letherii while going after the corrupt Letherii in power such as the factors, money lenders, debt holders, etc.
Sgt. Fiddler and Sgt. Gesler reunite at town with a tavern
Cpt. Faradan Sort and Beak reunite with Fist Keneb’s platoon who regrouped with 400 marines
Fist Keneb assigns 10 squads to Cpt. Sort to go find the rest of their squads
Hanradi Khalag’s war parties of 300 Edur surround the Malazan occupied tavern village
Sgt. Fiddler, Gesler, Hellian, and Urb engage with the Edur and things look dire especially as they’re running out of munitions
Sgt. Badan Gruk, Sgt. Sinter, and Sgt. Primly arrive to their rescue as fresh blood with more munitions, defeating the Edur

These squads landed on the southernmost coast, stole a fisherboat, and sailed east until they reached the mouth of the Letheras River. Besides having casualties against a Letherii galley ship, the tavern village battle is their first engagement.
The tavern village is a day away from Letheras.
Fist Keneb, Cpt. Faradan Sort, and Beak arrive at the tavern village.
All of the 800+ marine squads scattered across the Letherii coast and now regrouped and march together towards Letheras

Sirryn Kanar has K’risnan warlocks prepare several days to weave a wall of Letherii sorcery to crash upon and slaughter both Fist Keneb’s marines and Hanradi Khalag’s Edur war parties. Then leaves to face Adjunct Tavore’s fleet that just landed on the shore.

Beak sacrifices himself, opening all of his warrens to create a white-blue dome that protects the Malazan Army. The sorcery turns their hair white, heals all their scars, and repairs all of their equipment
Fiddler takes pity on the Edur and invites them into the protective dome. Hanradi Khalag surrenders and takes the Edur home to the north
Fist Keneb’s marines raises a barrow for Beak and marches for Letheras.
Cpl. Tarr catches a Letherii deserter that informs them of a postern gate the Malazans can use to get into the city
Adjunct Tavore sends in squads to slaughter Letherii, hardening them in their first combat
Sgt. Balm’s squad has not returned, they found Beak’s barrow and continue forward to find the rest of Keneb’s marines

cards.h: The Malaz 14th Army, the Bonehunters pt. 3

i.html: Fist Keneb plans to have his 800+ marines secure the city gate as Sgt. Fiddler, Gesler, Hellian, and Urb wreak as much havoc towards the city palace
Sgt. Balm reaches Fist Keneb’s marines inside Letheras.

The marines are running out of munitions and quarrels. Keneb orders Masan Gilani to ride back to Adjunct Tavore and have Tavore lead a cavalry ahead of the main army to help maintain their hold over the garrison
Sgt. Hellian gets separated, Sgt. Urb goes to find her
Sgt. Fiddler and Sgt. Gesler gets separated after ambushing a main City Garrison
Sgt. Fiddler gets his squad on top of a roof one street away from the Eternal Domicile
Silchas Ruin in dragon form descends upon the Malazans, thwarted by Fiddler firing a munition
Hedge and Quick Ben just arrive after using the Azath Gates to fast travel from the Refugium. Quick Ben unleashes his sorcery and repels Silchas Ruin. Silchas flees.
Adjunct Tavore arrives in Letheras, a Letherii garrison officer formally surrenders to her
Tavore encounters Letherii citizens crowding around Tehol and Brys Beddict. Rucket presents them as the new Emperor and Champion of the previous king
Sgt. Fiddler breaches the Eternal Domicile, killing Triban Gnol who just arrived from the arena.
Finadd Varat Taun and Samar Dev convince the Malazans to spare their lives so they could lead them to Emperor Rhulad
As the squad arrives to the arena, Hedge weeps as he watches Trull die by Sirryn Kanar’s hand. Quick Ben transports Sirryn Kanar to a realm of eternal torment.

names.n: Beak has access to all warrens
house all of the Gates of
Icarium was part Jaghut and part Toblakai
Mael, Elder God of the Seas
Redmask flops to the floor dead
the Seven Faces in the Rock
through the Azath which they freely travel
to free them from the Vow
